features.quote: **Max turns**: 40 (hard cap). Spiral onset almost always occurs by turn 25 if it occurs
features.justification_quote: 40 captures terminal phase without wasting tokens on random recovery

features.quote: Turn Cap at 40 … Beyond 40, models either remain stuck (wasting tokens) or stochastically escape via brute-force mutations that teach nothing about reliability.
**Fresh Session per Task** … Run each task in a fresh API session. Residual self-criticism from Task A can prime Task B (spillover), contaminating per-task trigger rates.
